Deprecation Notice:
The Marketing Version 202510 (Marketing October 2025) will be sunset on October 15, 2026. We recommend that you migrate to the latest versioned APIs to avoid disruptions. For information on all the supported versions, refer to the migrations documentation.
If you haven’t yet migrated and have questions, submit a request on the LinkedIn Developer Support Portal.

Blocks.Section: Ads Targeting Migration Guide to Bing Geo
Blocks.Text: For targeting locations, LinkedIn is migrating to a new geo data source (i.e. Bing geo). If you're a partner using LinkedIn standardized geo locations to create campaigns for ads targeting, please continue reading this guide.

Blocks.Section: Ads Targeting Migration Guide to Bing Geo
Blocks.Text: The new geo data enables customers to target millions of new geo locations, including counties and cities, providing a more comprehensive and accurate geo targeting experience. Currently, there are ~6k standardized locations, primarily in US. With Bing geo, around 2.6 million locations will be available at launch, and a large number of international locations. This migration guide provides the details of migrating from current geo endpoints/values to the new ones.

Blocks.Section: Ads Targeting Migration Guide to Bing Geo
Blocks.Text: Note

Blocks.Section: Ads Targeting Migration Guide to Bing Geo
Blocks.Text: All use of the Microsoft Bing Maps location data is subject to Microsoft Bing Maps and MapPoint Web Service End User Terms of Use and Embedded Maps Service Terms of Use and the Microsoft Privacy Statement which are now incorporated into our LinkedIn Marketing API Program Terms. By accessing any Microsoft Bing Maps location data, you're agreeing to be bound by these Microsoft terms.

Blocks.Section: How Migration is Planned
SectionPath: How Migration is Planned
Blocks.Text: The migration effort is divided among the following phases:

Blocks.Section: How Migration is Planned
SectionPath: How Migration is Planned
Blocks.Text:
Phase 1: Migrate from legacy geo API to typeahead and URN-to-name resolver API to retrieve locations.
Phase 2: Start using Bing geo locations in ad campaigns, in place of legacy locations.
Phase 3: Only Bing geo locations will be accepted in ad campaigns. Legacy locations can no longer be used for campaign creation, campaigns with legacy locations will be rejected.

Blocks.Section: Migration Phase 1: Move to Typeahead and URN-to-name resolver API from legacy geo API
SectionPath: Migration Phase 1: Move to Typeahead and URN-to-name resolver API from legacy geo API
Blocks.Text: In this phase, we recommend partners to use the typeahead API to retrieve legacy geo locations along with URN-to-name resolver API instead of legacy geo API.

Blocks.Section: Steps involved with Phase 1
SectionPath: Migration Phase 1: Move to Typeahead and URN-to-name resolver API from legacy geo API
Steps involved with Phase 1
Blocks.Text:
Partners have 3 months starting from 8/1/2019 to 10/31/2019 to migrate from legacy geo API to new typeahead API.
During phase 1, typeahead will return legacy geo locations, such as “urn:li:country:us”.
Typeahead API will NOT return Bing locations in phase 1. Bing locations will be available starting in phase 2.
In phase 2, the Bing geo locations will be returned as geo URN IDs via the Typeahead API. To convert geo URN IDs to localized labels, partners need to call the URN-to-name resolver API.
Ad campaigns still accepts the legacy locations during phase 1.

Are there any special rule changes for Bing Geo locations?
Blocks.Text:
LinkedIn has removed the existing parent-child relationship validation rule on geo entities. Partners no longer have to implement and support complex geo rules. Ad campaign creation won’t return error response in this scenario.
Example, if the United States and California (subregion or “children” of United States) are added to a campaign, our current campaign API fails the campaign creation and requires to remove one of them. After migration, this campaign creation will no longer error out.

Blocks.Section: Migration Phase 2: Use Bing Geo location in Ad campaigns
SectionPath: Migration Phase 2: Use Bing Geo location in Ad campaigns
Blocks.Text:
In Phase 2, LinkedIn starts serving Bing geo locations via the Typeahead API. We also auto migrate existing campaigns to the new geo data. Partners should start using the Bing geo locations via the typeahead API while creating campaigns.
Phase 2 commences from 12/12/2019 and ends by 3/31/2020.

Blocks.Section: Steps involved in Phase 2
SectionPath: Migration Phase 2: Use Bing Geo location in Ad campaigns
Steps involved in Phase 2
Blocks.Text:
Typeahead API will return ONLY Bing locations: Refer to this example.
Ad campaigns will start accepting Bing locations. Although legacy locations are acceptable in ad campaigns in this phase, we strongly advise against using the legacy geo entities because the backend will convert them to new geo entities.
To get the name for a Bing geo location, by the start of phase 2, Partners should have completed the changes to invoke urn-to-name resolver API. Refer to this example.
What happens to the existing campaigns already created with legacy geo entities?
Intelligent mapping: Where possible, LinkedIn will map existing campaign legacy locations to Bing geo gradually. Due to this if you do GET on campaign data, you may expect Bing location values from past campaigns. For example, if a campaign targets on urn:li:state:(urn:li:country:us,CA), LinkedIn will transform it to urn:li:geo:102095887 in the campaign’s targeting value.
Entity name or audience count change after migration: In scenarios where LinkedIn doesn’t find the exact match for the legacy location, newly mapped Bing locations could be of a different name or higher/lower audience count.
However, in some cases, where the legacy geo entity can't be mapped to the new geo entity, we'll notify you with suggested mapping. It won't affect creating a campaign or running campaign and no action is needed.

Blocks.Section: Steps for Phase 3
SectionPath: Migration Phase 3: Sunset of Legacy Geo locations in Ad campaigns

Blocks.Text:
No action required if phase 2 migration steps are completed.
campaign creation will accept ONLY Bing geo locations.

Create Ad campaign API will return an error response if any legacy locations are used for targeting.
Any existing campaign using a legacy location should be automatically mapped to Bing geo location.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: When are legacy geo locations values going to be deprecated? What are the corresponding Bing geo location values?

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: Legacy geo locations will be completely sunset by August 31, 2026. Beginning from phase 3, Ads targeting won't accept legacy geo locations in campaign creation. Legacy values examples: urn:li:countryGroup:{id},urn:li:country:{id},urn:li:state:{id},urn:li:region:{id} and corresponding examples in Bing geo are: urn:li:geo:{id}.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: To get the localized name for a Bing geo location, invoke the urn-to-name resolver endpoint. Both legacy and Bing geo values are supported in the same API. Refer to this example.

Blocks.Text: How to display search location result on load.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text:
LinkedIn campaign Manager will switch from legacy geo APIs to typeahead in Sep 2019. With that users of campaign Manager will no longer see a list of continents on first load but rather a blank search box. The locations will start populating results as user types the locations. Tree view display will no longer be shown.
Partners should show an empty search box and only show results as user enters search text.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: Can I use both legacy and new Bing geo in same campaign?

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: Yes, starting from phase 2, an ad campaign can include both legacy and Bing locations. For example: campaign can target both urn:li:geo:90000084 and urn:li:region:4573 in the same campaign. But from phase 3 only Bing geo locations are accepted in campaign creation.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: I have stored the created campaign locally in my own system, is there anything I need to pay attention?

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: Yes. During/after phase 2, the legacy values are updated by LinkedIn to new Bing geo values, so when GET the previously created campaigns, the values will be different from when it was stored. It is suggested to overwrite local stored values if necessary.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: When can I begin migration to typeahead finder and URN-to-name resolver API for geo entities?

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: Beginning from Phase 1, you can start using the Ads targeting typeahead finder and URN-to-name resolver API for legacy geo entities. And from phase 2, typeahead will return Bing geo locations. URN-to-name resolver API will always support legacy and Bing geo locations.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: By what date will my app break if I don’t take any action now?

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: We expect all our API partners to complete Phase 1 and Phase 2 by end of Mar 2020 and ramp new Bing geo entities. We highly recommend migrating as per our proposed phases as we'll be able to support your needs better. Beginning of Phase 3, if none of the actions were taken from previous phases, create campaign will break if legacy geo locations are used.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: When will the old location APIs be deprecated? What if I don't migrate?

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: The legacy locations API may be used in use cases other than Ads Targeting. The timeline for deprecating legacy locations for non-targeting uses cases is not yet decided. However, we require Ads API partners to align with this migration timeline, as after phase 2 migration, campaign creation won't take legacy geo entities even if the legacy locations API hasn't been deprecated for other use cases by that time.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: When will LinkedIn start ramping Bing geo (migration phase 2)?

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: Linkedin Ads will start to ramp Bing geo after phase 1 around 12/12/2019.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: By what date will the app break if migration phase 2 not completed?

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: We expect phase 2 migration to be complete by 3/31/2020. After that, legacy geo entities won't be supported any more in LinkedIn ads system and exception will be thrown if legacy geo entities are passed in to create campaign.

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: How will we be able to distinguish between the two locations names with the same name?

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: Typeahead API will provide metadata on the immediate parent to that geo (Georgia - United States vs. Georgia - Europe).

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: When will shares/ugc targeting locations migrate to Bing geo?

Blocks.Section: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SectionPath: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Blocks.Text: Share and UGC 'locations' fields will be deprecated on Sept 30th, 2021. Please use 'geoLocations' field for organic company post targeting.
